title: Separatrix Splitting under Quasiperiodic Forcing
exact_target: Find the exponentially small separatrix splitting when one quasiperiodic forcing component is small and the fast component remains of bounded size, including the change in asymptotics inside the perturbation series convergence region.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7800009 (AMR-077-0009). CC BY 4.0.
Giovanni Gallavotti, Separatrix Splitting for a Quasi Periodically Forced Pendulum (6 November 1998), Hamiltonian, definition of Delta, Diophantine sequence, and final Question.
